title: Interest balance failed
description: This event occurs when there is a failure in interest balance registration with product interest engine.

program_id.title: Program ID
program_id.description: Program ID to which the account belongs within your organization.

balance_id.title: Balance ID
balance_id.description: Unique balance identifier defined by Customer.

account_id.title: Pismo's account identifier
account_id.description: Account ID generated by Pismo's platform that uniquely identifies an account within your organization.

external_account_id.title: Client's account identifier
external_account_id.description: External account ID informed by the client that uniquely identifies an account within your organization.

interest_plan_id.title: Interest Plan ID identifier
interest_plan_id.description: A custom identifier string that indicates the interest plan to be used in the rate calculations.

start_cycle_date.title: Start cycle date
start_cycle_date.description: Date that the interest balance rentability cycle starts.

value_date.title: Value date
value_date.description: Date that the balance was effectively issued by client.

maturity_date.title: Maturity date
maturity_date.description: Date that the balance expires, finishing rentability cycle.

message.title: Error message
message.description: Description of error that occurred when trying to register new balance
examples: interest_plan_id must be a valid UUID
interest plan not found or not active for the given value_date
